title: Synchronization of Metronomes
summary: A Harvard lecture demonstration in which five metronomes on a movable board gradually fall into synchronization through coupling. Removing the coupling lets them drift out of step.
why: Cited as the canonical visual demonstration of coupled oscillators synchronizing, applied to analogies from brain waves to LLM populations.

quote.text: Everything that oscillates at roughly the same frequency and has some coupling synchronizes.
